subject: Request: CI change-chain + signed commit history for SIG assessment
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: SIG Assessment Team <sig-assess@assessors.org>, Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@finpartner.com>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: CI change-chain + signed commit history for SIG assessment

Hi Sara / SIG team,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the questionnaire. For the next tranche of artifacts the assessor requested (SIG V2 / CAIQ-adjacent controls) we need to provide: commit provenance for the last 18 months for the inference runtime, the CI/CD approval chain (who approved what and when), and evidence of gating (merge/rollout approvals). Specifically: commit hashes, signed tags where available, CI job run IDs, and the related change runbook.

Can you confirm whether the assessor needs raw git logs or a CSV export summarizing: commit_hash, author, timestamp, tag_signed(boolean), pipeline_job_id, approve_user? If CSV is OK we can redact personal emails and include corporate IDs.

I’ll loop Markus and Olga to collect the artifacts and prepare a deliverable (drive link + single PDF index). Targeting a package by Wed EOD PT if that works for your timeline.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Director, Security & Trust (on behalf of Compliance)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (placeholders) commit-audit-log.csv, ci-pipeline-approvals.pdf, change-runbook.md

From: Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@finpartner.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: SIG Assessment Team <sig-assess@assessors.org>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: CI change-chain + signed commit history for SIG assessment

Jonas — thanks. CSV summary is preferable for intake; assessor can ask for raw logs later if needed. Please include: commit_hash, committer (name only), commit_ts (ISO), tag_signed (yes/no), pipeline_job_id, approver_id (corporate username), action (merge/rollback/release), and a note column for manual exceptions.

Couple of clarifications:
- We need evidence of the merge gate policy being enforced (audit trail showing a gate check succeeded or a manual override with approver id).
- If you use ephemeral CI creds for merging or release, annotate that in the notes and include the short-lived token rotation proof.

Target Wed EOD PT works — assessor will aim to review within 48 hours of receipt. If you can attach a short README describing redaction decisions, that speeds validation.

Thanks — Sara
Sara Lewis
Security Lead, FinPartner

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@finpartner.com>
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 11:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: CI change-chain + signed commit history for SIG assessment

Sara / Jonas — copying the internal checklist and a short implementation note. We can produce both: a CSV summary (as requested) and a tarball with sanitized git logs. Quick notes:

- Where available, we’ll include signed tags (GPG) in the tag_signed column. For older repos that never used signed tags, we’ll note "no-signed-tags" and attach a short justification.
- For pipeline_job_id we’ll include the CI run URL and the run number (example: https://ci.redwood.com/jobs/78901).
- Approver IDs will be corporate usernames (not emails).
- Merge gate evidence: we’ll pull the branch protection audit entries and the policy enforcement logs (policy id INFRA-MERGE-GATE-v3).

I’ve started a folder in Drive (link below) where the artifacts will be staged. We’ll redact personal email addresses from commit bodies but keep author names; per Sara’s note we’ll include a README describing the redaction approach and the criteria used.

Commands I ran to extract provenance (examples):
- git log --pretty=format:'%H|%an|%ai|%D' --no-merges > commits.raw
- git tag -v <tag> (to verify signatures)
- curl -s "https://ci.redwood.com/api/v1/jobs/78901" | jq .

Drive staging: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cCIChangeChain

I’ll attach the CSV and the partial runbook in the next message once we validate redaction.

— Markus
Head of Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com, sara.lewis@finpartner.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: CI change-chain + signed commit history for SIG assessment

Olga — can you finalize the package and upload the PDF index to Drive? When you send the final, please also:
- Include a plain-English summary of any gaps (repos without signed tags, retained SE-only commits, etc.)
- Confirm that the merge gate logs include policy id and the approver id for manual overrides
- Provide JIRA pointer for the production rollout tied to each release (INFRA-4823 for the current release)

Forwarded message below for context.

On Mon, Jul 19, 2027 at 08:14 AM Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com> wrote:
> (original message to SIG team)
>
Thanks — Jonas

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@finpartner.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: CI change-chain + signed commit history for SIG assessment

Hi all — packaging complete and uploaded. Summary of artifacts provided (drive link + attached):

1) commit-audit-log.csv — summarized columns per Sara’s spec. Sensitive emails redacted to initials; corporate usernames preserved. Includes commit_hash, committer_name, commit_ts, tag_signed, pipeline_job_id, approver_id, action, notes.
2) ci-pipeline-approvals.pdf — exported approval timeline from our CI (includes run IDs and approver IDs; pages 12-14 show merge gate manual overrides).
3) change-runbook.md — operational runbook excerpt describing the rollout steps and who can trigger rollbacks.
4) supplemental: merge-gate-audit.json (sanitized) attached for deep-dive if needed (redacted).

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cCIChangeChain
JIRA: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-4823
HubSpot link (context): https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/0057-FINPARTNER

Notes on gaps and mitigations:
- Two legacy repos (internal_tools/_legacy_inference) did not have signed tags historically; we included a short mitigation note and timeline for tagging.
- For ephemeral CI credentials we included rotation logs and a sample token TTL proof (redacted).

Attachments (stubs): commit-audit-log.csv, ci-pipeline-approvals.pdf, change-runbook.md, merge-gate-audit.json

Let me know if assessor needs raw git objects (we can provide within an encrypted S3 share).

— Olga Petrov
Security Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference
